name: Lord Zangari
description: A human noble of Fiora whose schemes caused his downfall; he ordered a murderous music box for his wife and died from a trapped broach.

description_citations.text: "Zangari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At a ball Lady Tirelli tells Zangari his wife is spreading word of his business misfortune; he leaves angry.
timeline.quote: he left the party early, alone

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Iolanni tips Zangari about the artificer Sydri.
timeline.quote: Iolanni tipped Zangari of the artificer Sydri

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zangari orders from Sydri a music box that would give his wife a heart attack.
timeline.quote: gave her the order to create a musical box that would give his wife a heart attack

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zangari returns with the items and admires a boar's head broach that Sydri says is not for sale.
timeline.quote: the boar's head broach was a custom order for another client and was not for sale

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sydri explains how the music box will kill Aribelle on the third hearing.

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zangari threatens Sydri, and she gives him the music box and the broach as a gift.
timeline.quote: Zangari greedily snatched both boxes and left.

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zangari pins the broach on his cape, pricks his finger, laughs uncontrollably and dies feeling cold.
timeline.quote: There was a brief flash of pain as he had somehow managed to prick his finger on the broach.

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: he wondered to himself why he was feeling so cold on such a warm summer night

citation.text: "Zangari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
